Are public AI tools compromising student privacy? Ahead of a strict privacy deadline, Colorado colleges are locking down their technology protocols. Hear directly from an educational technology expert in this short clip on why institutions are moving to closed-environment systems and read the full investigation to see how this legislation impacts higher education data security.
